  • Method Details

    • startPregame

      public void startPregame()
      Pregame of poker game. Users can join or left the waiting room and wait until the game starts. This methods return only if there is some fatal error or the server socket is closed. This server socket can be closed by the host to start the game

    • startGame

      public void startGame(List<com.ucm.common.ClientStruct> players, List<com.ucm.common.BotStruct> bots, Spectator spectator, com.ucm.common.GameConfig config)
      Poker game method. This methods only return if the game finishes or there is some fatal error. In any case, all the connections are closed
      Parameters:
      players - connected and ready to play.
      bots - selected to play.
      spectator - in the game, if selected
      config - Game configuration for the game
